cause: Function-local valueNameId is not a global function identity: distinct lexical owners both mapped to0, redefining raw_arena_alloc_f0 in original81.
csharpDecision: CSharp uses source function identity for diagnostics and function-local SSA only within that function.
nativeDecision: Use unique context-global owner IR identity for private helper symbols and every caller; retain source declaration identity for diagnostics. Do not use local SSA alias IDs for global symbols.
